summary.text: Dave Muradian, listed by Ballotpedia as David Muradian Jr., is a Republican state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 9th Worcester District since January 2015 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a member of the House Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Muradian graduated from Sutton High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Worcester State University.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as legislative staffer.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Rules Committee and the Joint Committees on Health Care Financing, on Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery, and on Rules.
